svg.aria-label: Run or develop the Voice stack. Needs Python 3.12+, Bun and just, in addition to Rust and the platform build tools. $ just setup # Python environment + JavaScript dependencies $ just dev # Voice backend + desktop app $ bun run dev:server # API only, with the Python environment active $ just test # backend pytest suite $ bun run typecheck && bun run check API: 127.0.0.1:17493 owns SQLite, the models, the audio files and /mcp; development narration runs on 17494 MCP: voicebox.speak, voicebox.transcribe, voicebox.list_captures and voicebox.list_profiles; voicebox-mcp is the stdio-to-HTTP shim Packaged narration-worker startup has a known argument mismatch, and headless playback covers queued speech, not unclaimed narration streams; see the research map. Development data lives in data/, and the internals and updater still use upstream Voicebox naming and releases. Do not expose the API as if it were authenticated: most endpoints have none, and loopback binding with CORS is not an authorization layer. The retained Python /mini/* and /harnesses routes need loopback plus an install token, and they do not power the box.
